basic_info.description: Step into comfort and versatility in this beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2-bath home built in 1989. With a thoughtful floorplan and abundant natural light, this residence offers endless possibilities for modern living. The spacious east-facing living room is the heart of the home, bathed in morning sun and perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A cozy fireplace anchors the open-concept kitchen and dining area, creating an inviting space to gather and unwind. Two generously sized bedrooms on the main level each offer direct access to the backyard, while a full bathroom adds convenience and functionality. Downstairs, a separate entrance through the garage leads to a flexible bonus space ideal for use as a home office, guest suite, or third bedroom complete with its own bathroom. Outside, the tiered backyard is a private oasis featuring mature rose bushes, a covered patio, an open-air dining area, and a small deck for your morning cup of coffee. Low-maintenance landscaping means more time to enjoy the space and less time working on it. This home blends charm, practicality, and potential all in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods. Don't miss your chance to make it yours! Some of the photos have been virtually staged.
